# Official LFCA Objectives

Exam version: **2025-09-16**

The Linux Foundation publishes no official text finer than the competency name for LFCA. Verified 2026-08-09 in a browser: the certification page's Domains & Competencies accordion yields zero additional characters when fully expanded, and the program-changes page claims per-domain change outlines that do not exist on the page. Concepts therefore carry their competency name as objective_verbatim, and all finer structure is marked inferred. LFS200 learning objectives are attached separately in stage 4 as a course-derived tier, never as exam-derived official text. An 'objectives' array was present in the original schema to hold finer official bullets; it was removed rather than left permanently empty, because no such bullets exist to put in it.

## Linux Fundamentals — 16% (was 20%)

| Competency | 2025 status | Previously |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Linux Operating System | unchanged | Linux Operating System |
| Command Line | added | — |

Removed in 2025: **File Management Commands**, **System Commands**, **General Networking Commands**.

The three command-oriented competencies were collapsed into the single competency 'Command Line'.

## System Administration Fundamentals — 30% (was 20%)

| Competency | 2025 status | Previously |
| --- | --- | --- |
| System Administration | reworded (substantive) | System Administration Tasks |
| Best Practices | added | — |
| Networking | unchanged | Networking |
| Troubleshooting | unchanged | Troubleshooting |
| Disaster Recovery | added | — |

Largest weight increase of any domain (20% to 30%), and now the heaviest domain on the exam. Gained two entirely new competencies.

## Cloud Computing Fundamentals — 18% (was 20%)

| Competency | 2025 status | Previously |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Cloud Computing | reworded (substantive) | Cloud Computing Fundamentals |
| Performance/Availability | reworded (formatting) | Performance / Availability |
| Budgeting | reworded (substantive) | Cloud Costs and Budgeting |
| Best Practices | added | — |
| Networking | added | — |

Removed in 2025: **Serverless**.

Serverless is no longer a named competency. Two new competencies appeared, one of which ('Networking') duplicates a System Administration competency name and must be kept distinct by domain.

## Security Fundamentals — 14% (was 16%)

| Competency | 2025 status | Previously |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Security | reworded (substantive) | Security Basics |
| Sensitive Data | reworded (substantive) | Data Security |
| Compliance | added | — |

Removed in 2025: **Network Security**, **System Security**.

Four competencies reduced to three. The archived pre-2025 page rendered 'System Security:' with a trailing colon; treated here as a typographic artifact of that page, not part of the competency name.

## DevOps Fundamentals — 12% (was 16%)

| Competency | 2025 status | Previously |
| --- | --- | --- |
| DevOps Basics | unchanged | DevOps Basics |
| Git Concepts | unchanged | Git Concepts |
| Containers | unchanged | Containers |

Removed in 2025: **Deployment Environments**.

All three surviving competency names are unchanged; only the removal and the weight drop distinguish this domain from its predecessor.

## IT Project Management Fundamentals — 10% (was 8%)

Renamed from **Supporting Applications and Developers**.

| Competency | 2025 status | Previously |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Project Management | reworded (substantive) | Software Project Management |
| Software Application Architecture | unchanged | Software Application Architecture |
| Functional Analysis | unchanged | Functional Analysis |
| Open Source Software and Licensing | reworded (formatting) | Open-source Software and Licensing |

This domain was renamed outright and reweighted from 8% to 10%. Its renaming is the clearest single contradiction of the Linux Foundation's published claim that the domains were unchanged.
